description: This file defines the LikePredicateImpl class, which implements a 'like' predicate using regular expressions for pattern matching within a query framework. It extends AbstractSinglePredicate and provides methods to convert wildcard patterns into regex syntax.

classes.name: LikePredicateImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a 'like' predicate that converts wildcard patterns into regex and integrates with the query predicates framework.

methods.name: LikePredicateImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with a value to match against.

methods.name: convertToRegexSyntaxAndGetOption
methods.description: Converts the pattern string with wildcards into a regex string, optimizing for prefix/postfix matches.

methods.name: replaceRepeatingWildcards
methods.description: Simplifies consecutive wildcards '*' to a single '*' to optimize regex translation.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a PredicateVisitor and passes the regex pattern for evaluation.
